value.multiple-redirect-uris-and-token-refresh: GitHub OAuth apps, an authentication mechanism, now support multiple redirect URIs and better token refresh, simplifying multi-environment deployments for developers.
value.per-model-token-breakdown-in-the-usage-r: GitHub Copilot's usage report, an AI coding assistant's cost tracking, now details token consumption by AI model, enabling organizations to optimize usage costs.
value.visual-studio-code-1-134: Visual Studio Code, a popular code editor, released version 1.134, bringing new features and improvements that continue its rapid iteration cycle for developers.
value.azure-copilot-introduces-direct-access-t: Azure Copilot, an AI assistant for cloud management, now offers direct access to specialized AI agents, streamlining complex cloud management tasks for users.
value.public-preview-azure-linux-on-wsl: Azure Linux, a Microsoft-supported Linux distribution, is now a public preview on WSL, letting developers test against the same optimized cloud environment.
value.visual-studio-code-1-133: Visual Studio Code, a popular open-source editor, released version 1.133, continuing its rapid iteration with new improvements and features for developers.
value.public-preview-markdown-for-agents-in-az: Azure App Service, a cloud platform, now has public preview Markdown support for AI agents, simplifying formatted content delivery from agent-based applications.
value.generally-available-dragon-copilot-physi: Dragon Copilot's physician apps and agents, AI-assisted clinical workflow tools, are now generally available on Microsoft Marketplace, bringing AI to healthcare providers.
value.public-preview-sql-formatter-in-mssql-ex: The MSSQL extension for VS Code, a database tool, now offers a public preview SQL Formatter, helping developers consistently format T-SQL queries.
value.microsoft-fabric-item-recovery-enabled-b: Microsoft Fabric's Item Recovery, a data platform feature, will be enabled by default, providing automatic protection against accidental deletion for data platform teams.
